front_trigger: Para saludar con energía y pasarle la pelota al cliente de inmediato:
phrase: Happy to connect! How's your week going so far?
phonetic: /ˈhæpi tu kəˈnɛkt! haʊz jɔːr wiːk ˈɡoʊɪŋ soʊ fɑːr?/
meaning: Saludo cálido y profesional que te quita los nervios y hace hablar al cliente.
example: Hi Mark, happy to connect! How's your week going so far?

front_trigger: Para tomar el control de la llamada y empezar sin rodeos incómodos:
phrase: Whenever you're ready, we can dive right in.
phonetic: /wɛnˈɛvər jʊr ˈrɛdi, wi kæn daɪv raɪt ɪn/
meaning: Demuestra liderazgo y respeto por el tiempo del cliente.
example: Whenever you're ready, we can dive right in. How would you like to kick things off?

front_trigger: Para preguntar amablemente cómo quiere arrancar la reunión:
phrase: How would you like to kick things off?
phonetic: /haʊ wʊd ju laɪk tu kɪk θɪŋz ɒf?/
meaning: Le cede la palabra al cliente para que exponga su problema.
example: Great to meet you! How would you like to kick things off today?

front_trigger: Para preguntar si el proyecto es desde cero o hay código existente:
phrase: Are we starting from scratch, or is there an existing codebase?
phonetic: /ɑːr wi ˈstɑːrtɪŋ frʌm skrætʃ, ɔːr ɪz ðɛər ən ɪɡˈzɪstɪŋ ˈkoʊdˌbeɪs?/
meaning: Pregunta fundamental de arquitectura que demuestra madurez.
example: To get a clear picture: are we starting from scratch, or is there an existing codebase?

front_trigger: Para preguntar si ya tienen los diseños listos en Figma:
phrase: Do you already have the designs ready in Figma?
phonetic: /du ju ɔːlˈrɛdi hæv ðə dɪˈzaɪnz ˈrɛdi ɪn ˈfɪɡmə?/
meaning: Aclara si tú tienes que diseñar UI o solo implementar código.
example: Do you already have the designs ready in Figma, or are we defining wireframes together?

front_trigger: Para preguntar cuál es la fecha límite u objetivo de lanzamiento:
phrase: What's your target launch deadline for the app stores?
phonetic: /wʌts jɔːr ˈtɑːrɡɪt lɔːntʃ ˈdɛdˌlaɪn fɔːr ði æp stɔːrz?/
meaning: Te ayuda a calcular el alcance y negociar tiempos realistas.
example: What's your target launch deadline for publishing to Google Play and the App Store?

front_trigger: Para preguntar cuál es el objetivo principal del MVP (Fase 1):
phrase: What does success look like for this first milestone?
phonetic: /wʌt dʌz səkˈsɛs lʊk laɪk fɔːr ðɪs fɜːrst ˈmaɪlˌstoʊn?/
meaning: Pregunta de consultor estrella: alinea expectativas exactas.
example: To make sure we stay focused, what does success look like for this first milestone?

front_trigger: Para preguntar cómo se comunica y coordina el equipo a diario:
phrase: What's your team's day-to-day communication workflow?
phonetic: /wʌts jɔːr tiːmz deɪ-tu-deɪ kəˌmjuːnɪˈkeɪʃən ˈwɜːrkˌfloʊ?/
meaning: Averigua si usan Slack, Jira, GitHub o llamadas diarias.
example: What's your team's workflow? Do you prefer Slack standups or Jira tickets?

front_trigger: Para decir que puedes empezar a producir desde el día 1 sin perder tiempo:
phrase: I can hit the ground running on day one.
phonetic: /aɪ kæn hɪt ðə ɡraʊnd ˈrʌnɪŋ ɒn deɪ wʌn/
meaning: La frase #1 que aman los founders gringos: cero atraso en onboarding.
example: Since I already know your stack, I can hit the ground running on day one.

front_trigger: Para decir que no necesitas que te supervisen ni te lleven de la mano:
phrase: I don't need onboarding hand-holding; I work autonomously.
phonetic: /aɪ doʊnt niːd ˈɒnˌbɔːrdɪŋ ˈhændˌhoʊldɪŋ; aɪ wɜːrk ɔːˈtɒnəməsli/
meaning: Transmite total tranquilidad a clientes ocupados.
example: You can count on me; I don't need onboarding hand-holding.

front_trigger: Para decir que te haces cargo del proyecto desde la arquitectura hasta el store:
phrase: I take full ownership from architecture to store deployment.
phonetic: /aɪ teɪk fʊl ˈoʊnərˌʃɪp frʌm ˈɑːrkɪˌtɛktʃər tu stɔːr dɪˈplɔɪmənt/
meaning: Demuestra seniority de Lead: no dejas cosas a medias.
example: I take full ownership of mobile apps, from clean architecture to store deployment.

front_trigger: Para decir que tu prioridad es llevar el proyecto con éxito a la meta:
phrase: My main goal is getting this across the finish line.
phonetic: /maɪ meɪn ɡoʊl ɪz ˈɡɛtɪŋ ðɪs əˈkrɒs ðə ˈfɪnɪʃ laɪn/
meaning: Enfocado en resultados y entregables, no solo en picar código.
example: My main goal is helping your team get this MVP across the finish line on time.

front_trigger: Para plantear una solución diciendo lo que NO harías primero:
phrase: To tackle this, I wouldn't guess—I'd profile it first.
phonetic: /tu ˈtæk.əl ðɪs, aɪ ˈwʊdənt ɡɛs—aɪd ˈproʊfaɪl ɪt fɜːrst/
meaning: Respuesta científica de Lead: tomas decisiones con datos, no a ciegas.
example: To tackle this laggy feed, I wouldn't guess—I'd profile memory and CPU first.

front_trigger: Para frenar una mala idea del cliente y proponer una mejor alternativa:
phrase: I'd recommend against that because [...]; instead, we could [...]
phonetic: /aɪd ˌrɛkəˈmɛnd əˈɡɛnst ðæt bɪˈkɒz... ɪnˈstɛd, wi kʊd.../
meaning: Consultoría de alto valor: ahorras dinero y dolores de cabeza al cliente.
example: I'd recommend against rewriting from scratch; instead, we could refactor the payment module.

front_trigger: Para explicar que una decisión técnica implica una concesión (trade-off):
phrase: The trade-off here is performance versus development time.
phonetic: /ðə ˈtreɪd-ɒf hɪər ɪz pərˈfɔːrməns ˈvɜːrsəs dɪˈvɛləpmənt taɪm/
meaning: Hablar de trade-offs es la marca distintiva de un Senior Developer.
example: The trade-off here is slightly higher memory usage for instant local cache.

front_trigger: Para advertir que una solución apresurada creará deuda técnica futura:
phrase: A quick hack might introduce technical debt down the road.
phonetic: /ə kwɪk hæk maɪt ˌɪntrəˈdjuːs ˈtɛknɪkəl dɛt daʊn ðə roʊd/
meaning: Proteges la estabilidad del producto a largo plazo.
example: I wouldn't hardcode this; a quick hack might introduce technical debt.

front_trigger: Cuando no escuchaste o no entendiste lo que dijo el cliente:
phrase: Sorry, your audio cut out for a second. Could you repeat that last part?
phonetic: /ˈsɒri, jɔːr ˈɔːdioʊ kʌt aʊt fɔːr ə ˈsɛkənd. kʊd ju rɪˈpiːt ðæt lɑːst pɑːrt?/
meaning: Pone la culpa en la conexión de internet, nunca en tu nivel de inglés.
example: Sorry, your audio cut out for a second. Could you repeat that last question?

front_trigger: Para confirmar que entendiste bien los requerimientos sin decir "I don't understand":
phrase: Just to make sure we're on the same page, the priority is [...], right?
phonetic: /dʒʌst tu meɪk ʃʊər wɪər ɒn ðə seɪm peɪdʒ, ðə praɪˈɒrəti ɪz... raɪt?/
meaning: Valida prioridades y te da 10 segundos para ordenar tu mente.
example: Just to make sure we're on the same page, the priority is fixing the checkout bug, right?

front_trigger: Para pedirle al cliente que aclare un término específico o requerimiento:
phrase: Could you clarify what you mean by [...] in this context?
phonetic: /kʊd ju ˈklærəfaɪ wʌt ju miːn baɪ... ɪn ðɪs ˈkɒntɛkst?/
meaning: Pregunta profesional que demuestra precisión técnica.
example: Could you clarify what you mean by real-time sync in this context?

front_trigger: Para responder sobre cuántas horas semanales puedes dedicar:
phrase: I can commit 25 to 30 hours per week with a 4-hour daily overlap with US time.
phonetic: /aɪ kæn kəˈmɪt ˈtwɛnti-faɪv tu ˈθɜːrti ˈaʊərz pɜːr wiːk wɪð ə fɔːr-aʊər ˈdeɪli ˈoʊvərˌlæp.../
meaning: Respuesta perfecta para clientes de EE.UU. o Europa.
example: I can commit 25 to 30 hours per week with a 4-hour daily overlap with Eastern time.

front_trigger: Para dar una estimación inicial sin pillarte los dedos con una fecha fija:
phrase: As a rough ballpark estimate, an MVP like this usually takes 4 to 6 weeks.
phonetic: /æz ə rʌf ˈbɔːlˌpɑːrk ˈɛstɪmət, ən ɛm-viː-piː laɪk ðɪs ˈjuːʒuəli teɪks.../
meaning: Demuestra experiencia sin comprometerte a ciegas a fechas imposibles.
example: As a rough ballpark estimate, integrating the payment flow usually takes 2 to 3 weeks.

front_trigger: Para preguntar cuáles son los siguientes pasos al terminar la llamada:
phrase: What are the next steps on your end to move this forward?
phonetic: /wʌt ɑːr ðə nɛkst stɛps ɒn jɔːr ɛnd tu muːv ðɪs ˈfɔːrwərd?/
meaning: Cierre de ventas clásico: empuja al cliente a tomar la decisión de contratar.
example: Awesome call! What are the next steps on your end to move this forward?

front_trigger: Para prometer un resumen de propuesta por el chat de Upwork hoy mismo:
phrase: I'll follow up with a brief scope summary in the Upwork chat today.
phonetic: /aɪl ˈfɒloʊ ʌp wɪð ə briːf skoʊp ˈsʌməri ɪn ði ˈʌpˌwɜːrk tʃæt təˈdeɪ/
meaning: Te asegura dejar huella escrita profesional antes de que hablen con otro candidato.
example: I'll follow up with a brief scope summary and estimated milestones in the Upwork chat today.

front_trigger: Para despedirte con entusiasmo profesional:
phrase: Thanks for your time! Really looking forward to collaborating on this.
phonetic: /θæŋks fɔːr jɔːr taɪm! ˈrɪəli ˈlʊkɪŋ ˈfɔːrwərd tu kəˈlæbəˌreɪtɪŋ ɒn ðɪs/
meaning: Deja una impresión positiva, segura y confiable.
example: Thanks for your time, Mark! Really looking forward to collaborating on this project.
